LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Literature 1.1.1 Introduction to Oral Literature - Definition - Genres/ Cla, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Oral Literature 1.1.1 Introduction to Oral Literature - Definition - Genres/ Cla.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Literature 1.1.1 Introduction to Oral Literature - Definition - Genres/ Cla.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Literature 1.1.1 Introduction to Oral Literature - Definition - Genres/ Cla.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Literature 1.1.1 Introduction to Oral Literature - Definition - Genres/ Cla.

2. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

3. When practising Fiction and Non- Fiction 1.3.1 Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Features of prose fic, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction and Non- Fiction 1.3.1 Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Features of prose fic.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction.

6. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. happiness
   C. run
   D. quickly
